description: This file defines a utility enum LogLocator that provides static methods and properties for locating and managing log files within a specified directory, primarily for OpenClaw plugin logs. It includes methods for retrieving the latest log file, ensuring the log directory exists, and providing paths for launchd logs.

classes.name: LogLocator
classes.description: An enumeration providing static utility functions for locating and managing log files related to the OpenClaw application on macOS.

methods.name: logDir
methods.description: Returns the URL directory for logs, either from environment variable 'OPENCLAW_LOG_DIR' or defaulting to '/tmp/openclaw'.

methods.name: stdoutLog
methods.description: Returns the URL for the stdout log file within the log directory.

methods.name: gatewayLog
methods.description: Returns the URL for the gateway log file within the log directory.

methods.name: ensureLogDirExists
methods.description: Creates the log directory if it does not already exist.

methods.name: modificationDate(for:)
methods.description: Retrieves the modification date of a file at the given URL.

methods.name: bestLogFile
methods.description: Returns the most recent log file in the log directory matching specific prefixes and extension, or nil if none are found.

methods.name: launchdLogPath
methods.description: Provides the path for launchd stdout/stderr logs.

methods.name: launchdGatewayLogPath
methods.description: Provides the path for gateway launchd logs.
